roles.name: admin
roles.description: Full system access with all permissions. Can manage users, roles, equipment, alerts, sensors, and all system configurations.

roles.name: manager
roles.description: Operational management access. Can view all data, manage equipment and alerts, but cannot modify system configuration or user management.

roles.name: operator
roles.description: Standard operational access. Can view data, acknowledge alerts, and perform routine operations. Cannot modify configurations.

roles.name: readonly
roles.description: View-only access to all data. Cannot make any modifications or acknowledge alerts.
